name: Feature request
about: Suggest a change to an existing skill, script, or doc. 提议改现有技能、脚本或文档。
title: "[feature] "
---

A **new** recruiting skill belongs on the **New skill proposal / 新技能提案** form, not here. Vulnerabilities belong in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/LofiSu/recruiting-skills/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## Skill

Which existing package this changes: `researcher-recruiting-skill`, `research-talent-scout`, or repository / docs / CI.

## Problem

Which request or workflow fails today, and which file you hit (`SKILL.md`, a script under `research-talent-scout/scripts/`, the README, or the demo report).

## Proposal

The behavior you want. Say whether it would change a `SKILL.md` trigger (`name` or `description`). Trigger text stays put unless the current wording is a defect.

This project will not accept requests for login flows, guessed email addresses, candidate ranking, automated employment decisions, or automated outreach. See [references/compliance.md](https://github.com/LofiSu/recruiting-skills/blob/main/references/compliance.md).

## Public sources

Which public professional pages or scholarly APIs the change would read. `--degree` on the connectors is a caller-supplied index label, not an API fact.
